title: Reserve Bank of India (Non-Banking Financial Companies – Know Your Customer) Directions, 2025

obligations.text: Regulated Entities are required to follow certain customer identification procedures while undertaking a transaction either by establishing an account-based relationship or otherwise, and to monitor their transactions.
obligations.quote: require Regulated Entities (REs) to follow certain customer identification procedures while undertaking a transaction either by establishing an account-based relationship or otherwise, and to monitor their transactions.

obligations.text: These Directions shall be called the Reserve Bank of India (Non-Banking Financial Companies – Know Your Customer) Directions, 2025.
obligations.quote: These Directions shall be called the Reserve Bank of India (Non-Banking Financial Companies – Know Your Customer) Directions, 2025.

obligations.text: These directions shall come into effect on the day they are placed on the official website of the RBI.
obligations.deadline: The day they are placed on the official website of the RBI
obligations.quote: These directions shall come into effect on the day they are placed on the official website of the RBI.

obligations.text: These Directions shall be applicable to all categories of Non-Banking Financial Company, for all layers, unless specified otherwise.
obligations.applies_to: All categories of Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFCs), for all layers
obligations.quote: These Directions shall be applicable to all categories of Non-Banking Financial Company (hereinafter collectively referred to as 'NBFCs' and individually as an 'NBFC'), for all layers, unless specified otherwise.

obligations.text: Where applicable laws and regulations of the host country prohibit implementation of these directions, the NBFC shall bring the same to the notice of the RBI.
obligations.quote: where applicable laws and regulations prohibit implementation of these guidelines, the NBFC shall bring the same to the notice of the RBI

obligations.text: Where there is a variance between KYC/AML standards prescribed by the RBI and those of the host country regulators, branches and subsidiaries of the NBFC abroad shall adopt the more stringent regulation of the two.
obligations.applies_to: branches / subsidiaries of the NBFC located abroad
obligations.quote: in case there is a variance in KYC / AML standards prescribed by the RBI and the host country regulators, branches / subsidiaries of the NBFC shall adopt the more stringent regulation of the two

obligations.text: For a trust customer, the identification of beneficial owner(s) shall include the author of the trust, the trustee, the beneficiaries with 10 percent or more interest in the trust, and any other natural person exercising ultimate effective control over the trust through a chain of control or ownership.
obligations.quote: the identification of beneficial owner(s) shall include identification of the author of the trust, the trustee, the beneficiaries with 10 percent or more interest in the trust

obligations.text: An authorised officer of the NBFC shall record the comparison of the certified copy with the original on the copy, as per the provisions contained in the Act.
obligations.quote: an authorised officer of the NBFC shall record the comparison on the copy as per the provisions contained in the Act

obligations.text: A Designated Director, who may be the Managing Director or a whole-time Director duly authorised by the Board, must be designated by the NBFC to ensure overall compliance with obligations under chapter IV of the PML Act and the Rules.
obligations.quote: a person whom the NBFC designates to ensure overall compliance with the obligations imposed under chapter IV of the PML Act and the Rules

obligations.text: Where a customer's KYC Identifier is generated by CKYCR and provided to the NBFC in the process of opening an account, the NBFC shall share the same with the concerned customer.
obligations.quote: once the customer’s KYC Identifier is generated by CKYCR and provided to the NBFC, the latter shall share the same with the concerned

obligations.text: When a customer's OVD does not have an updated address, the NBFC shall deem the listed documents (utility bill not more than two months old, property or municipal tax receipt, pension payment orders, or allotment letter/leave and licence agreement for accommodation) or their equivalent e-documents to be OVDs for the limited purpose of proof of address.
obligations.quote: the NBFC shall deem the following documents or the equivalent e-documents thereof to be OVDs for the limited purpose of proof of address

obligations.text: The customer must submit an OVD with current address within a period of three months.
obligations.applies_to: customer (the party referred to as 'they' in the preceding text, which is not shown in this extract)
obligations.deadline: within a period of three months
obligations.quote: they are required to submit an OVD with current address within a period of three months.

obligations.text: The customer must submit an OVD with current address within three months of submitting the documents specified at (b).
obligations.deadline: within three months of submitting the documents specified at (b) above
obligations.quote: the customer shall submit OVD with current address within a period of three months of submitting the documents specified at (b) above

obligations.text: Where the OVD presented by a foreign national does not contain address details, the NBFC must accept documents issued by Government departments of foreign jurisdictions, and a letter issued by the Foreign Embassy or Mission in India, as proof of address.
obligations.quote: the NBFC shall accept documents that Government departments of foreign jurisdictions issue, and a letter that the Foreign Embassy or Mission in India issues, as proof of address.

obligations.text: The NBFC must deem a document to be an OVD even if its name has changed after issuance, provided the change is supported by a marriage certificate issued by the State Government or a Gazette notification indicating the change of name.
obligations.quote: the NBFC shall deem a document to be an OVD even if there is a change in the name subsequent to its issuance provided that it is supported by a marriage certificate

obligations.text: The CDD, at the time of commencement of an account-based relationship or for occasional transactions of ₹50,000 or more (single or connected several), or any international money transfer operations, shall include identification of the customer and verification of identity using reliable and independent sources, and obtaining information on the purpose and intended nature of the business relationship where applicable.
obligations.quote: The CDD, at the time of commencement of an account-based relationship or while carrying out occasional transaction of an amount equal to or exceeding ₹50,000 whether conducted as a single transaction or several transactions that appear to be connected, or any international money transfer operations, shall include:

obligations.text: As part of CDD, the NBFC shall take reasonable steps to understand the nature of the customer's business, and its ownership and control.
obligations.quote: Taking reasonable steps to understand the nature of the customer's business, and its ownership and control;

obligations.text: As part of CDD, the NBFC shall determine whether a customer is acting on behalf of a beneficial owner, and identify the beneficial owner and take all steps to verify the beneficial owner's identity using reliable and independent sources of identification.
obligations.quote: Determining whether a customer is acting on behalf of a beneficial owner, and identifying the beneficial owner and taking all steps to verify the identity of the beneficial owner, using reliable and independent sources of identification.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall have a KYC policy.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall have a KYC policy. The Board of Directors of the NBFC, or any committee to which the Board has delegated power, shall duly approve the KYC policy.

obligations.text: The Board of Directors of the NBFC, or any committee to which the Board has delegated power, shall duly approve the KYC policy.
obligations.applies_to: Board of Directors of the NBFC; any committee to which the Board has delegated power
obligations.quote: The Board of Directors of the NBFC, or any committee to which the Board has delegated power, shall duly approve the KYC policy.

obligations.text: The NBFC's KYC policy shall include the four key elements: Customer Acceptance Policy; Risk Management; Customer Identification Procedures (CIP); and Monitoring of Transactions.
obligations.quote: The KYC policy shall include following four key elements: (i) Customer Acceptance Policy; (ii) Risk Management; (iii) Customer Identification Procedures (CIP); and (iv) Monitoring of Transactions

obligations.text: The NBFC's KYC policy shall, inter alia, incorporate provisions for periodic updation of KYC.
obligations.quote: The KYC policy shall, inter alia, incorporate provisions for the following: (i) Periodic updation of KYC

obligations.text: The NBFC's KYC policy shall incorporate any exceptional measures for KYC updation, such as requiring a recent photograph, physical presence, or a more frequent updation schedule than the minimum prescribed.
obligations.quote: Any exceptional measures for KYC updation, such as requiring a recent photograph, physical presence, or a more frequent updation schedule than the minimum prescribed.

obligations.text: The NBFC's KYC policy shall incorporate provisions for obtaining a copy of OVD or deemed OVD, for the purpose of proof of change of address during KYC updation.
obligations.quote: Obtaining a copy of OVD or deemed OVD, for the purpose of proof of change of address during KYC updation.

obligations.text: The NBFC's KYC policy shall incorporate provisions for providing facility of updation / periodic updation of KYC at any branch.
obligations.quote: Providing facility of updation / periodic updation of KYC at any branch.

obligations.text: The NBFC's KYC policy shall incorporate provisions for change of registered Mobile Number for accounts opened in non-face-to-face mode.
obligations.quote: Change of registered Mobile Number for accounts opened in non-face-to-face mode.

obligations.text: Every NBFC which is part of a group shall implement group-wide programmes against money laundering and terror financing, including group-wide policies for sharing information required for client due diligence and money laundering and terrorist finance risk management.
obligations.applies_to: every NBFC which is part of a group
obligations.quote: every NBFC which is part of a group, shall implement group-wide programmes against money laundering and terror financing, including group-wide policies for sharing information

obligations.text: Group-wide programmes shall include adequate safeguards on the confidentiality and use of information exchanged, including safeguards to prevent tipping-off.
obligations.applies_to: NBFCs which are part of a group (group-wide programmes)
obligations.quote: such programmes shall include adequate safeguards on the confidentiality and use of information exchanged, including safeguards to prevent tipping-off.

obligations.text: NBFC's policy framework shall seek to ensure compliance with the PML Act / Rules, including regulatory instructions in this regard, and shall provide a bulwark against money laundering, terrorist financing, proliferation financing and other related risks.
obligations.quote: NBFC’s policy framework shall seek to ensure compliance with PML Act / Rules, including regulatory instructions in this regard and shall provide a bulwark against threats arising from money laundering

obligations.text: The NBFC shall carry out Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Risk Assessment exercises periodically to identify, assess and take effective measures to mitigate its ML and TF risk for clients, countries or geographic areas, products, services, transactions or delivery channels.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall carry out ‘Money Laundering (ML) and Terrorist Financing (TF) Risk Assessment’ exercises periodically to identify, assess and take effective measures to mitigate its money laundering and terrorist financing risk

obligations.text: The assessment process shall consider all the relevant risk factors before determining the level of overall risk and the appropriate level and type of mitigation to be applied.
obligations.quote: The assessment process shall consider all the relevant risk factors before determining the level of overall risk and the appropriate level and type of mitigation to be applied.

obligations.text: While preparing the internal risk assessment, the NBFC shall take cognizance of the overall sector-specific vulnerabilities, if any, that the regulator / supervisor may share with the NBFC from time to time.
obligations.quote: While preparing the internal risk assessment, the NBFC shall take cognizance of the overall sector-specific vulnerabilities, if any, that the regulator / supervisor may share with the NBFC from time to time.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall properly document its risk assessment, and the documentation shall be proportionate to the nature, size, geographical presence, complexity of activities / structure, etc. of the NBFC.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall properly document its risk assessment and it shall be proportionate to the nature, size, geographical presence, complexity of activities / structure, etc. of the NBFC.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall review its risk assessment at least annually.
obligations.quote: However, the NBFC shall review it at least annually.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall present the outcome of the ML and TF risk assessment exercise to the Board or a committee of the Board to which the Board has delegated power in this regard.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall present the outcome of the exercise to the Board or any committee of the Board to which the Board has delegated power in this regard.

obligations.text: The outcome of the risk assessment exercise shall be made available to competent authorities and self-regulating bodies.
obligations.quote: The outcome shall also be made available to competent authorities and self-regulating bodies.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall apply a Risk Based Approach (RBA) for mitigation and management of the risks identified on its own or through national risk assessment.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall apply a Risk Based Approach (RBA) for mitigation and management of the risks (identified on its own or through national risk assessment)

obligations.text: The NBFC shall have Board-approved policies, controls and procedures for the risk based approach to mitigating and managing ML/TF risks.
obligations.quote: and shall have Board-approved policies, controls and procedures in this regard.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall implement a CDD programme having regard to the ML/TF risks identified and the size of its business.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall implement a CDD programme, having regard to the ML / TF risks identified and the size of business.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall monitor the implementation of the controls and enhance them if necessary.
obligations.quote: Further, the NBFC shall monitor the implementation of the controls and enhance them if necessary.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall ensure compliance with its KYC Policy by specifying who constitutes 'Senior Management' for the purpose of KYC compliance.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall ensure compliance with KYC Policy through: (1) Specifying as to who constitute ‘Senior Management’ for the purpose of KYC compliance.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall ensure compliance with its KYC Policy by allocating responsibility for effective implementation of policies and procedures.
obligations.quote: Allocation of responsibility for effective implementation of policies and procedures.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall ensure compliance with its KYC Policy through independent evaluation of the compliance functions of its policies and procedures, including legal and regulatory requirements.
obligations.quote: Independent evaluation of the compliance functions of the NBFC’s policies and procedures, including legal and regulatory requirements.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall ensure compliance with its KYC Policy through a concurrent / internal audit system to verify compliance with KYC / AML policies and procedures.
obligations.quote: Concurrent / internal audit system to verify compliance with KYC / AML policies and procedures.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall submit quarterly audit notes and compliance to the Audit Committee.
obligations.quote: Submission of quarterly audit notes and compliance to the Audit Committee.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall ensure that it does not outsource the decision-making functions of determining compliance with KYC norms.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall ensure that it does not outsource the decision-making functions of determining compliance with KYC norms.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall communicate the name, designation, address and contact details of the Designated Director to the FIU-IND and RBI.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall communicate the name, designation, address and contact details of the Designated Director to the FIU-IND and RBI.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall not nominate the Principal Officer as the 'Designated Director'.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall not nominate the Principal Officer as the 'Designated Director'.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall communicate the name, designation, address, and contact details of the Principal Officer to the FIU-IND and RBI.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall communicate the name, designation, address, and contact details of the Principal Officer to the FIU-IND and RBI.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall not open any account in an anonymous or fictitious / benami name.
obligations.quote: not open any account in an anonymous or fictitious / benami name.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall open no account where it is unable to apply appropriate CDD measures, either due to non-cooperation of the customer or unreliability of the documents / information furnished by the customer.
obligations.quote: open no account where it is unable to apply appropriate CDD measures, either due to non-cooperation of the customer or unreliability of the documents / information furnished by the customer.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall not undertake a transaction or an account-based relationship without following the CDD procedure.
obligations.quote: not undertake a transaction or an account-based relationship without following the CDD procedure.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall specify the mandatory information to be sought for KYC purposes while opening an account and during the periodic updation.
obligations.quote: specify the mandatory information to be sought for KYC purposes while opening an account and during the periodic updation.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall obtain additional information, where its internal KYC Policy has not specified such information requirement, only with the explicit consent of the customer.
obligations.quote: obtain additional information, where its internal KYC Policy has not specified such information requirement, with the explicit consent of the customer.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall apply the CDD procedure at the Unique Customer Identification Customer (UCIC) level.
obligations.quote: apply the CDD procedure at the Unique Customer Identification Customer (UCIC) level.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall follow the CDD Procedure for all the joint account holders, while opening a joint account.
obligations.quote: follow the CDD Procedure for all the joint account holders, while opening a joint account.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall clearly spell out the circumstances in which a customer is permitted to act on behalf of another person / entity.
obligations.quote: clearly spell out the circumstances in which a customer is permitted to act on behalf of another person / entity.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall put in place a suitable system to ensure that the identity of the customer does not match with any person or entity whose name appears in the sanctions lists indicated in Chapter IX of these Directions.
obligations.quote: put in place a suitable system to ensure that the identity of the customer does not match with any person or entity, whose name appears in the sanctions lists indicated in Chapter IX of these Directions.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall verify the Permanent Account Number (PAN) (if obtained) from the verification facility of the issuing authority.
obligations.quote: verify the Permanent Account Number (PAN) (if obtained) from the verification facility of the issuing authority.

obligations.text: The NBFC must verify the customer's digital signature on the equivalent e-document (if obtained) as per the provisions of the Information Technology Act, 2000 (21 of 2000).
obligations.applies_to: Non-Banking Financial Companies (regulated entities under these Directions)
obligations.quote: verify the customer’s digital signature on the equivalent e-document (if obtained) as per the provisions of the Information Technology Act, 2000 (21 of 2000).

obligations.text: The NBFC must verify the Goods and Services Tax (GST) number from the search / verification facility of the issuing authority, where the GST details are available.
obligations.applies_to: Non-Banking Financial Companies (regulated entities under these Directions)
obligations.quote: verify the Goods and Services Tax (GST) number from the search / verification facility of the issuing authority, where the GST details are available.

obligations.text: The Customer Acceptance Policy shall not result in denial of a financial facility to members of the general public, especially those who are financially or socially disadvantaged, including Persons with Disabilities (PwDs).
obligations.quote: The Customer Acceptance Policy shall not result in denial of a financial facility to members of the general public, especially those who are financially or socially disadvantaged, including the Persons with Disabilities (PwDs).

obligations.text: The NBFC shall not reject an application for onboarding or periodic updation of KYC without application of mind.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall not reject an application for onboarding or periodic updation of KYC without application of mind.

obligations.text: The officer concerned shall duly record the reason(s) for rejecting an application for onboarding or periodic updation of KYC.
obligations.quote: The officer concerned shall duly record the reason(s) for rejection.

obligations.text: Where the NBFC suspects money laundering or terrorist financing and reasonably believes that performing the CDD process will tip off the customer, it shall not pursue the CDD process and shall instead file an STR with FIU-IND.
obligations.quote: it shall not pursue the CDD process and instead file an STR with FIU-IND.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall have a risk-based approach for risk management.
obligations.quote: For risk management, the NBFC shall have a risk-based approach which includes the following.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall categorise customers into low, medium, and high-risk categories, based on its assessment and risk perception.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall categorise customers into low, medium, and high-risk categories, based on its assessment and risk perception.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall undertake risk categorisation based on parameters such as customer identity, social/financial status, nature of business activity, business and location information, geographical risk, products/services, delivery channel, and transaction types including cash, cheque/monetary instruments, wire transfers and forex transactions.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall undertake risk categorisation based on parameters such as the customer's identity, social / financial status, nature of business activity, and information about the customer's business and its location

obligations.text: The NBFC shall keep the risk categorisation of a customer and the specific reasons for such categorisation confidential and shall not reveal this information to the customer to avoid tipping off.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall keep the risk categorisation of a customer and the specific reasons for such categorisation confidential and shall not reveal this information to the customer to avoid tipping off.

obligations.text: Provided that the NBFC collects various other non-intrusive information from different categories of customers relating to the perceived risk and specifies the same in the KYC policy.
obligations.quote: the NBFC collects various other non-intrusive information from different categories of customers relating to the perceived risk and specifies the same in the KYC policy.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall undertake identification of customers in the cases listed in paragraph 21, including commencement of an account-based relationship, international money transfers for non-account holders, doubt about customer identification data, certain product sales or payments above ₹50,000, walk-in transactions of ₹50,000 or more, and suspected structuring below ₹50,000.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall undertake identification of customers in the following cases: (1) Commencement of an account-based relationship with the customer.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall ensure that it does not seek introductions while opening accounts.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall ensure it does not seek introductions while opening accounts.

obligations.text: The NBFC must obtain the records or information of customer due diligence carried out by a third party immediately from the third party or from the Central KYC Records Registry, when relying on third-party CDD.
obligations.quote: The NBFC obtains the records or information of the customer due diligence carried out by the third party immediately from the third party or from the Central KYC Records Registry.

obligations.text: The NBFC must take adequate steps to satisfy itself that the third party will make copies of identification data and other relevant documentation relating to CDD available upon request, without delay.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall take adequate steps to satisfy itself that the third party will make copies of identification data and other relevant documentation relating to the customer due diligence requirements available, upon request, without delay.

obligations.text: The third party relied upon must be regulated, supervised or monitored by a regulator and have measures in place for CDD and record-keeping in line with the PML Act requirements.
obligations.quote: A regulator regulates, supervises, or monitors the third party, and the third party has measures in place for compliance with customer due diligence and record-keeping requirements in line with the requirements and obligations under the PML Act.

obligations.text: The NBFC must ensure that the third party is not based in a country or jurisdiction assessed as high-risk.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall ensure that the third party is not based in a country or jurisdiction assessed as high-risk.

obligations.text: The NBFC will have the ultimate responsibility for customer due diligence and for undertaking enhanced due diligence measures, as applicable, even when relying on a third party.
obligations.quote: The NBFC will have the ultimate responsibility for customer due diligence and undertaking enhanced due diligence measures, as applicable.

obligations.text: For CDD, the NBFC shall obtain from an individual, while establishing an account-based relationship or dealing with an individual who is a beneficial owner, authorised signatory or power of attorney holder related to a legal entity, the Aadhaar number where the individual desires to receive a benefit or subsidy under a scheme notified under section 7 of the Aadhaar Act, or voluntarily submits it to an NBFC or RE notified under the first proviso to section 11A(1) of the PML Act.
obligations.quote: For undertaking CDD, the NBFC shall obtain the following from an individual while establishing an account-based relationship or while dealing with the individual

obligations.text: For CDD, the NBFC shall obtain from an individual the proof of possession of Aadhaar number where the NBFC can carry out offline verification.
obligations.quote: the proof of possession of Aadhaar number where the NBFC can carry out offline verification; or

obligations.text: For CDD, the NBFC shall obtain from an individual the proof of possession of Aadhaar number where it cannot carry out offline verification, or any OVD or equivalent e-document containing the details of identity and address.
obligations.quote: the proof of possession of Aadhaar number where the NBFC cannot carry out the offline verification or any OVD or the equivalent e-document thereof

obligations.text: For CDD, the NBFC shall obtain from an individual the KYC Identifier with explicit consent to download records from CKYCR.
obligations.quote: the KYC Identifier with an explicit consent to download records from CKYCR; and

obligations.text: For CDD, the NBFC shall obtain from an individual the PAN or equivalent e-document thereof, or Form No. 60 as defined in Income-tax Rules, 1962.
obligations.quote: the PAN or the equivalent e-document thereof or Form No. 60 as defined in Income-tax Rules, 1962; and

obligations.text: Where offline verification can be carried out for proof of possession of Aadhaar, the NBFC shall carry out offline verification.
obligations.quote: where offline verification can be carried out, the NBFC shall carry out offline verification.

obligations.text: For an equivalent e-document of any OVD, the NBFC shall verify the digital signature as per the Information Technology Act, 2000 and rules thereunder, and take a live photo as specified in paragraph 24.
obligations.quote: the NBFC shall verify the digital signature as per the provisions of the Information Technology Act, 2000 (21 of 2000)

obligations.text: Where offline verification cannot be carried out for an OVD or proof of possession of Aadhaar, the NBFC shall carry out verification through digital KYC as specified in paragraph 24.
obligations.quote: where offline verification cannot be carried out, the NBFC shall carry out verification through digital KYC as specified under paragraph 24 below.

obligations.text: For a KYC Identifier, the NBFC shall retrieve the KYC records online from the CKYCR in accordance with paragraph 63.
obligations.quote: the NBFC shall retrieve the KYC records online from the CKYCR in accordance with paragraph 63

obligations.text: Where the NBFC cannot perform e-KYC authentication for an individual seeking a scheme benefit or subsidy due to injury, illness, infirmity or similar causes, the NBFC shall, apart from obtaining the Aadhaar number, perform identification preferably by offline verification or alternatively by obtaining a certified copy of another OVD or its equivalent e-document.
obligations.quote: the NBFC shall, apart from obtaining the Aadhaar number, perform identification preferably by carrying out offline verification or alternatively by obtaining the certified copy

obligations.text: In the situation covered by the preceding proviso, an official of the NBFC shall invariably carry out the identification process (the section text is cut off at this point).
obligations.quote: An official of the NBFC shall invariably carry out

obligations.text: Exception handling in CDD done in this manner shall also be a part of the concurrent audit as mandated in paragraph 12.
obligations.quote: CDD done in this manner, and such exception handling shall also be a part of the concurrent audit as mandated in paragraph 12.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall maintain the cases of exception handling in a centralised exception database containing grounds of granting exception, customer details, name of the designated official authorising the exception and additional details, if any.
obligations.quote: the cases of exception handling in a centralised exception database. The database shall contain the details of grounds of granting exception, customer details, name of the designated official authorising the exception

obligations.text: The NBFC shall subject the exception database to periodic internal audit or inspection and shall make the database available for supervisory review.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall subject the database to periodic internal audit / inspection and the NBFC shall make database available for supervisory review.

obligations.text: Where a customer submits a proof of possession of Aadhaar containing the Aadhaar number, the NBFC shall ensure the customer redacts or blacks out the Aadhaar number where authentication of Aadhaar number is not required under proviso (i).
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall, where its customer submits a proof of possession of Aadhaar Number containing Aadhaar Number, ensure that such customer redacts or blacks out his Aadhaar number through appropriate means

obligations.text: The NBFC shall ensure that the use of Aadhaar and proof of possession of Aadhaar is in accordance with the Aadhaar (Targeted Delivery of Financial and Other Subsidies Benefits and Services) Act, 2016 and the regulations made thereunder.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall ensure that the use of Aadhaar, proof of possession of Aadhaar etc., is in accordance with the Aadhaar (Targeted Delivery of Financial and Other Subsidies Benefits and Services) Act, 2016

obligations.text: Where a customer is desirous of receiving any benefit or subsidy under a scheme notified under section 7 of the Aadhaar Act, 2016, the customer shall provide the Aadhaar number to the NBFC.
obligations.quote: the customer shall provide the Aadhaar number to the NBFC. In other cases, customers may provide the Aadhaar number voluntarily.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall develop an application for digital KYC process and make it available at customer touch points for undertaking KYC of its customers.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall develop an application for digital KYC process and make it available at customer touch points for undertaking KYC of its customers

obligations.text: The NBFC shall undertake the KYC process only through this authenticated application.
obligations.quote: shall undertake the KYC process only through this authenticated application

obligations.text: The NBFC shall control the access to the Application and shall ensure that unauthorised persons do not use it.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall control the access to the Application and shall ensure that unauthorised persons do not use it.

obligations.text: Authorised officials shall access the Application only through a login-id and password or a Live OTP or Time OTP controlled mechanism that the NBFC provides.
obligations.quote: Authorised officials shall access the Application only through a login-id and password or a Live OTP or Time OTP controlled mechanism that the NBFC provides.

obligations.text: The customer must visit the location of the authorised official of the NBFC, or the authorised official must visit the customer, for the purpose of KYC.
obligations.quote: The customer, for the purpose of KYC, shall visit the location of the authorised official of the NBFC or vice-versa.

obligations.text: The original OVD must remain in the possession of the customer.
obligations.quote: The original OVD shall be in possession of the customer.

obligations.text: The NBFC must ensure that the authorised officer takes a live photograph of the customer and embeds it in the Customer Application Form (CAF).
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall ensure that the authorised officer takes a Live photograph of the customer and embeds the same photograph in the Customer Application Form (CAF).

obligations.text: The NBFC's system application must put a readable watermark on the customer's live photograph containing the CAF number, GPS coordinates, authorised official's name, unique employee code assigned by the NBFC, and date (DD:MM:YYYY) and time stamp (HH:MM:SS).
obligations.quote: the NBFC's system Application shall put a watermark in readable form, containing the CAF number, GPS coordinates, authorised official's name, unique employee code

obligations.text: The NBFC's application must capture only a live photograph of the customer and must not capture any printed or video graphed photograph.
obligations.quote: The NBFC's Application shall have the feature that it captures only a live photograph of the customer and does not capture any printed or video graphed photograph.

obligations.text: The background behind the customer while capturing the live photograph must be white, and no other person may come into the frame.
obligations.quote: The background behind the customer while capturing live photograph shall be of white colour and no other person shall come into the frame while capturing the live photograph of the customer.

obligations.text: The authorised officer must capture a live photograph of the original OVD or proof of possession of Aadhaar, where offline verification cannot be carried out, placed horizontally and vertically from above, and apply the readable watermark.
obligations.quote: the authorised officer shall capture the live photograph of the original OVD or proof of possession of Aadhaar where offline verification cannot be carried out (placed horizontally), vertically from above and shall apply a water-marking

obligations.text: The authorised officer must ensure there is no skew or tilt in the mobile device while capturing the live photograph of the original documents.
obligations.quote: The authorised officer shall ensure there is no skew or tilt in the mobile device while capturing the live photograph of the original documents.

obligations.text: The authorised officer must capture the live photograph of the customer and original documents in proper light so that they are clearly readable and identifiable.
obligations.quote: The authorised officer shall capture the live photograph of the customer and his original documents in proper light so that they are clearly readable and identifiable.

obligations.text: The authorised officer must fill all entries in the CAF as per the documents and information furnished by the customer.
obligations.quote: the authorised officer shall fill all the entries in the CAF as per the documents and information furnished by the customer.

obligations.text: The OTP shall be sent to the customer's own mobile number, and upon successful OTP validation the NBFC will treat it as the customer's signature on the CAF.
obligations.quote: OTP’ shall be sent to customer’s own mobile number. Upon successful validation of the OTP, the NBFC will treat it as the customer’s signature on CAF.

obligations.text: If the customer does not have their own mobile number, the NBFC may use a family, relative or known person's mobile number for OTP, and must clearly mention it in the CAF.
obligations.quote: if the customer does not have their own mobile number, the NBFC may use the mobile number of their family / relatives / known persons for this purpose and clearly mention it in the CAF.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall not use the mobile number of an authorised officer registered with the NBFC for the customer's signature.
obligations.quote: In any case, the NBFC shall not use the mobile number of authorised officer registered with the NBFC for the customer signature.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall check that the mobile number used for customer signature is not the mobile number of the authorised officer.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall check that the mobile number used in customer signature is not the mobile number of the authorised officer.

obligations.text: The authorised officer shall provide a declaration about the capturing of the live photograph of the customer and original document.
obligations.quote: The authorised officer shall provide a declaration about the capturing of the live photograph of the customer and original document.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall verify the authorised officer with an OTP sent to his mobile number registered with the NBFC, and upon successful validation treat it as the authorised officer's signature on the declaration.
obligations.quote: the NBFC shall verify the authorised officer with One Time Password (OTP) which will be sent to his mobile number registered with the NBFC. Upon successful OTP validation, the NBFC shall treat it as the authorised officer’s signature on the declaration.

obligations.text: The live photograph of the authorised officer shall also be captured in the authorised officer's declaration.
obligations.quote: The live photograph of the authorised officer shall also be captured in this authorised officer’s declaration.

obligations.text: The Application shall give information about completion of the process and submission of the activation request to the NBFC's activation officer, and generate the transaction-id / reference-id number of the process.
obligations.quote: the Application shall give information about the completion of the process and submission of activation request to activation officer of the NBFC, and also generate the transaction-id / reference-id number of the process.

obligations.text: The authorised officer shall intimate the transaction-id / reference-id number to the customer for future reference.
obligations.quote: The authorised officer shall intimate the details regarding transaction-id / reference-id number to the customer for future reference.

obligations.text: The authorised officer shall check and verify that information in the picture of the document matches the information entered by the authorised officer in the CAF.
obligations.quote: information available in the picture of the document matches with the information entered by authorised officer in CAF.

obligations.text: The authorised officer shall check and verify that the customer's live photograph matches the photo available in the document.
obligations.quote: live photograph of the customer matches with the photo available in the document.

obligations.text: The authorised officer shall check and verify that all necessary details, including mandatory fields, are properly filled in the CAF.
obligations.quote: the authorised officer has properly filled all of the necessary details in CAF, including mandatory field.

obligations.text: On successful verification, the CAF shall be digitally signed by the authorised officer of the NBFC, who will take a print of the CAF and obtain signatures or thumb-impression of the customer.
obligations.quote: On Successful verification, the CAF shall be digitally signed by authorised officer of the NBFC who will take a print of CAF, get signatures / thumb-impression of

obligations.text: Customer must give specific consent for authentication through OTP for accounts opened using Aadhaar OTP based e-KYC in non-face-to-face mode.
obligations.quote: The Customer shall give specific consent for the authentication through OTP.

obligations.text: NBFC shall ensure that transaction alerts, OTP, etc., are sent only to the mobile number of the customer registered with Aadhaar, for accounts opened using Aadhaar OTP based e-KYC in non-face-to-face mode.
obligations.quote: the NBFC shall ensure that it sends transaction alerts, OTP, etc., only to the mobile number of the customer registered with Aadhaar.

obligations.text: NBFC shall have a Board-approved policy delineating a robust process of due diligence for dealing with requests for change of mobile number in such accounts.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall have a Board-approved policy delineating a robust process of due diligence for dealing with requests for change of mobile number in such accounts.

obligations.text: NBFC shall ensure the aggregate balance of all deposit accounts of the customer does not exceed Rupees One Lakh, and if exceeded, shall cease the account's operation until CDD under paragraph 25(6) is completed.
obligations.quote: The aggregate balance of all the deposit accounts of the customer shall not exceed Rupees One Lakh. In case the balance exceeds the threshold, the NBFC shall cease the account's operation

obligations.text: NBFC shall ensure the aggregate of all credits in a financial year, across all deposit accounts taken together, does not exceed Rupees Two Lakh.
obligations.quote: The aggregate of all credits in a financial year, in all the deposit accounts taken together, shall not exceed Rupees Two Lakh.

obligations.text: NBFC shall sanction only term loans for borrowal accounts opened using Aadhaar OTP based e-KYC, with aggregate term loans sanctioned not exceeding Rs 60,000 in a year.
obligations.quote: As regards borrowal accounts, the NBFC shall sanction only term loans. The aggregate amount of term loans sanctioned shall not exceed ₹60,000 in a year.

obligations.text: NBFC shall not allow deposit and borrowal accounts opened using OTP based e-KYC to operate for more than one year unless identification is carried out as per paragraph 23 or paragraphs 26 and 27 (V-CIP).
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall not allow accounts, both deposit and borrowal, opened using OTP based e-KYC to operate for more than one year unless it carries out identification

obligations.text: If NBFC uses Aadhaar details under paragraphs 26 and 27, it shall follow the process in its entirety, including fresh Aadhaar OTP authentication.
obligations.quote: If the NBFC uses Aadhaar details under paragraph 26 and 27 it shall follow the process in its entirety, including fresh Aadhaar OTP authentication.

obligations.text: If CDD is not completed within a year, NBFC shall close deposit accounts immediately.
obligations.quote: If the NBFC does not complete the CDD procedure as mentioned above within a year; (a) in respect of deposit accounts, the NBFC shall close the same immediately

obligations.text: If CDD is not completed within a year, NBFC shall allow no further debits in borrowal accounts.
obligations.quote: (b) in respect of borrowal accounts, the NBFC shall allow no further debits.

obligations.text: NBFC shall obtain a declaration from the customer that no other account has been opened nor will be opened using OTP based KYC in non-face-to-face mode with any other RE.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall obtain declaration from the customer to the effect that no other account has been opened nor will be opened using OTP based KYC in non-face-to-

obligations.text: NBFC must clearly indicate that accounts are opened using OTP based e-KYC.
obligations.quote: NBFC shall clearly indicate that such accounts are opened using OTP based e-KYC

obligations.text: Other REs must not open accounts based on the KYC information of accounts opened with OTP based e-KYC procedure in non-face-to-face mode.
obligations.quote: other REs shall not open accounts based on the KYC information of accounts opened with OTP based e-KYC procedure in non-face- to-face mode

obligations.text: NBFC must have strict monitoring procedures, including systems to generate alerts in case of any non-compliance or violation, to ensure compliance with the above-mentioned conditions.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall have strict monitoring procedures including systems to generate alerts in case of any non-compliance / violation, to ensure compliance with the above-mentioned conditions.

obligations.text: When undertaking CDD of a proprietorship firm through V-CIP, the NBFC shall also obtain the equivalent e-document of the activity proofs with respect to the proprietorship firm, as mentioned in paragraph 31 and paragraph 32, apart from undertaking CDD of the proprietor.
obligations.quote: Provided that in case of CDD of a proprietorship firm, the NBFC shall also obtain the equivalent e-document of the activity proofs with respect to the proprietorship firm, as mentioned in paragraph 31 and paragraph 32, apart from undertaking CDD of the proprietor.

obligations.text: The NBFC opting to undertake V-CIP shall adhere to the minimum standards set out in this section.
obligations.quote: The NBFC opting to undertake V-CIP, shall adhere to the following minimum standards:

obligations.text: The NBFC shall comply with the RBI guidelines on minimum baseline cyber security and resilience framework for NBFCs, as updated from time to time, as well as other general guidelines on IT risks.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall have complied with the RBI guidelines on minimum baseline cyber security and resilience framework for NBFCs, as updated from time to time as well as other general guidelines on IT risks.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall house the technology infrastructure on its own premises.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall house the technology infrastructure on its own premises and the V-CIP connection and interaction shall necessarily originate from its own secured network domain.

obligations.text: The V-CIP connection and interaction shall necessarily originate from the NBFC's own secured network domain.
obligations.quote: the V-CIP connection and interaction shall necessarily originate from its own secured network domain.

obligations.text: Any technology related outsourcing for the V-CIP process shall comply with relevant RBI guidelines.
obligations.quote: Any technology related outsourcing for the process shall comply with relevant RBI guidelines.

obligations.text: Where the NBFC uses a cloud deployment model, it shall ensure that ownership of data in such model rests with the NBFC only and all data, including video recording, is transferred to the NBFC's exclusively owned/leased server(s) promptly.
obligations.applies_to: NBFC using a cloud deployment model
obligations.quote: Where the NBFC uses a cloud deployment model, it shall ensure that ownership of data in such model rests with the NBFC only and all the data including video recording is transferred

obligations.text: The NBFC shall ensure end-to-end encryption of data between customer device and the hosting point of the V-CIP application, as per appropriate encryption standards.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall ensure end-to-end encryption of data between customer device and the hosting point of the V-CIP application, as per appropriate encryption standards.

obligations.text: The V-CIP infrastructure / application shall be capable of preventing connection from IP addresses outside India or from spoofed IP addresses.
obligations.quote: The V-CIP infrastructure / application shall be capable of preventing connection from IP addresses outside India or from spoofed IP addresses.

obligations.text: The video recordings shall contain the live GPS co-ordinates (geo tagging) of the customer undertaking the V-CIP and date and time stamp.
obligations.quote: The video recordings shall contain the live GPS co-ordinates (geo tagging) of the customer undertaking the V-CIP and date and time stamp.

obligations.text: The quality of the live video in the V-CIP shall be adequate to allow identification of the customer beyond doubt.
obligations.quote: The quality of the live video in the V-CIP shall be adequate to allow identification of the customer beyond doubt.

obligations.text: The application shall have components with face liveness / spoof detection as well as face matching technology with high degree of accuracy.
obligations.quote: The application shall have components with face liveness / spoof detection as well as face matching technology with high degree of accuracy, even though the ultimate responsibility of any customer identification rests with the NBFC.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall take due cognizance of special needs, if any, of the customer during liveness check.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall take due cognizance of special needs, if any, of the customer during liveness check.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall regularly update the technology infrastructure including application software as well as workflows, based on experience of detected / attempted / near-miss cases of forged identity.
obligations.quote: Based on experience of detected / attempted / ‘near-miss’ cases of forged identity, the NBFC shall regularly update the technology infrastructure including application software as well as workflows.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall report any detected case of forged identity through V-CIP as a cyber event under extant regulatory guidelines.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall report any detected case of forged identity through V-CIP as a cyber event under extant regulatory guidelines.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall subject the V-CIP infrastructure to necessary tests such as Vulnerability Assessment, Penetration testing and a Security Audit to ensure its robustness and end-to-end encryption capabilities.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall subject the V-CIP infrastructure to necessary tests such as Vulnerability Assessment, Penetration testing and a Security Audit to ensure its robustness and end-to-end encryption capabilities.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall mitigate any critical gap reported under this process before rolling out its implementation.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall mitigate any critical gap reported under this process before rolling out its implementation.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall subject the V-CIP application software and relevant APIs / webservices to appropriate testing of functional, performance, and maintenance strength before being used in live environment.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall subject the V-CIP application software and relevant APIs / webservices to appropriate testing of functional, performance, and maintenance strength before being used in live environment.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall roll out the V-CIP application only after closure of any critical gap found during such tests.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall roll out the application only after closure of any critical gap found during such tests.

obligations.text: Tests of the V-CIP application software shall be carried out periodically in conformity with internal / regulatory guidelines.
obligations.quote: Such tests shall also be carried out periodically in conformity with internal / regulatory guidelines.

obligations.text: Each NBFC shall formulate a clear workflow and standard operating procedure for V-CIP and ensure adherence to it.
obligations.quote: Each NBFC shall formulate a clear workflow and standard operating procedure for V-CIP and ensure adherence to it.

obligations.text: The V-CIP process shall be operated only by officials of the NBFC specially trained for this purpose.
obligations.quote: The V-CIP process shall be operated only by officials of the NBFC specially trained for this purpose.

obligations.text: The official shall be capable of carrying out a liveness check and detecting any other fraudulent manipulation or suspicious conduct of the customer and acting upon it.
obligations.quote: The official shall be capable to carry out liveness check and detect any other fraudulent manipulation or suspicious conduct of the customer and act upon it.

obligations.text: The liveness check shall not result in exclusion of persons with special needs.
obligations.quote: The liveness check shall not result in exclusion of person with special needs.

obligations.text: In case of call drop / disconnection during V-CIP, a fresh session shall be initiated.
obligations.quote: However, in case of call drop / disconnection, fresh session shall be initiated.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall vary the sequence and / or type of questions, including those indicating liveness of the interaction, during video interactions to establish that the interactions are real-time and not pre-recorded.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall vary the sequence and / or type of questions, including those indicating the liveness of the interaction, during video interactions to establish that the interactions are real-time and not pre-recorded.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall reject the account opening process if it observes any prompting at the customer end.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall reject the account opening process if it observes any prompting at the customer end.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall factor in whether the V-CIP customer is an existing or new customer, or a case rejected earlier, or a name in a negative list, at an appropriate stage of workflow.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall factor in the fact that the V-CIP customer is an existing or new customer, or if the case relates to one rejected earlier or if the name appears in some negative list, at an appropriate stage of workflow.

obligations.text: The authorised official of the NBFC performing the V-CIP shall record audio and video, capture a photograph of the customer present for identification, and obtain the identification information using any one of the listed methods: OTP based Aadhaar e-KYC authentication, offline verification of Aadhaar, KYC records downloaded from CKYCR using the customer-provided KYC identifier, or an equivalent e-document of OVDs including DigiLocker documents.
obligations.applies_to: Authorised official of the NBFC performing the V-CIP
obligations.quote: The authorised official of the NBFC performing the V-CIP shall record audio and video as well as capture a photograph of the customer present for identification and obtain the identification information using any one of the following

obligations.text: The NBFC shall ensure to redact or blackout the Aadhaar number in terms of paragraph 23.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall ensure to redact or blackout the Aadhaar number in terms of paragraph 23.

obligations.text: In case of offline verification of Aadhaar using XML file or Aadhaar Secure QR Code, the NBFC shall ensure that the XML file or QR code generation date is not older than three working days from the date of carrying out V-CIP.
obligations.deadline: Not older than three working days from the date of carrying out V-CIP
obligations.quote: the NBFC shall ensure that the XML file or QR code generation date is not older than three working days from the date of carrying out V-CIP.

obligations.text: If the entire V-CIP process cannot be completed at one go or seamlessly, the NBFC shall ensure that it undertakes the video process of the V-CIP within three working days of downloading or obtaining the identification information through CKYCR, Aadhaar authentication or equivalent e-document.
obligations.deadline: Within three working days of downloading or obtaining the identification information
obligations.quote: the NBFC shall ensure that it undertakes video process of the V-CIP within three working days of downloading / obtaining the identification information through CKYCR / Aadhaar authentication / equivalent e-

obligations.text: Where the video process of the V-CIP is split for rare cases, the NBFC shall ensure that no incremental risk is added due to this.
obligations.quote: However, the NBFC shall ensure that no incremental risk is added due to this.

obligations.text: If the customer's address differs from that indicated in the OVD, the NBFC shall capture suitable records of the current address, as per the existing requirement.
obligations.quote: If the address of the customer is different from that indicated in the OVD, the NBFC shall capture suitable records of the current address, as per the existing requirement.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall capture a clear image of the PAN card displayed by the customer during the process, except where the customer provides an e-PAN.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall capture a clear image of PAN card displayed by the customer during the process, except in cases where e-PAN is provided by the customer.

obligations.text: NBFC shall verify the PAN details from the database of the issuing authority, including through DigiLocker.
obligations.quote: NBFC shall verify the PAN details from the database of the issuing authority ,including through DigiLocker.

obligations.text: The use of a printed copy of an equivalent e-document, including an e-PAN, is not valid for the V-CIP.
obligations.quote: The use of printed copy of equivalent e-document, including an e-PAN is not valid for the V-CIP.

obligations.text: The authorised official of the NBFC shall ensure that the customer's photograph in the Aadhaar/OVD and PAN/e-PAN matches the customer undertaking the V-CIP, and that identification details in Aadhaar/OVD and PAN/e-PAN match the details provided by the customer.
obligations.quote: The authorised official of the NBFC shall ensure that photograph of the customer in the Aadhaar / OVD and PAN / e-PAN matches with the customer undertaking the V-CIP

obligations.text: The NBFC shall make all accounts opened through V-CIP operational only after subjecting them to concurrent audit to ensure the integrity of process and its acceptability of its outcome.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall make all accounts opened through V-CIP operational only after subjecting them to concurrent audit to ensure the integrity of process

obligations.text: The NBFC shall appropriately comply with all matters not specified under the paragraph but required under other statutes such as the Information Technology (IT) Act.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall appropriately comply with all matters not specified under the paragraph but required under other statutes such as the Information Technology (IT) Act.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall store the entire data and recordings of V-CIP in a system located in India, in a safe and secure manner, with date and time stamps that afford easy historical data search.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall store the entire data and recordings of V-CIP in a system / system located in India. The NBFC shall ensure that the video recording is stored in a safe and secure manner

obligations.text: The NBFC shall preserve the activity log along with the credentials of the official performing the V-CIP.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall preserve the activity log along with the credentials of the official performing the V-CIP.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall obtain a self-attested photograph from the customer when opening an account under the simplified procedure.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall obtain a self-attested photograph from the customer.

obligations.text: The designated officer of the NBFC must certify under his signature that the person opening the account has affixed his signature or thumb impression in his presence.
obligations.quote: The designated officer of the NBFC certifies under his signature that the person opening the account has affixed his signature or thumb impression in his presence.

obligations.text: The account opened under the simplified procedure shall remain operational initially for twelve months, within which CDD as per paragraph 23 or paragraphs 26 and 27 shall be carried out.
obligations.quote: The account shall remain operational initially for a period of twelve months, within which CDD as per paragraph 23 or paragraph 26 and 27 shall be carried out.

obligations.text: Balances in all accounts of the customer taken together shall not exceed ₹50,000 at any point of time.
obligations.quote: Balances in all their accounts taken together shall not exceed ₹50,000 at any point of time.

obligations.text: The total credit in all accounts taken together shall not exceed Rupees One Lakh in a year.
obligations.quote: The total credit in all the accounts taken together shall not exceed Rupees One Lakh in a year.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall make the customer aware that no further transactions will be permitted until the full KYC procedure is completed if the balance or credit limits in items (iv) and (v) are breached.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall make customer aware that no further transactions will be permitted until the full KYC procedure is completed in case Directions (4) and (5) above are breached by him.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall notify the customer when the balance reaches ₹40,000 or the total credit in a year reaches ₹80,000 that appropriate KYC documents must be submitted, otherwise operations in the account shall be stopped when the limits in items (iv) and (v) are exceeded.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall notify the customer when the balance reaches ₹40,000 or the total credit in a year reaches ₹80,000 that appropriate documents for conducting the KYC must be submitted

obligations.text: The account shall be monitored and, where there is suspicion of ML/TF activities or other high-risk scenarios, the identity of the customer shall be established as per paragraph 23 or paragraphs 26 and 27.
obligations.quote: The account shall be monitored and when there is suspicion of ML/TF activities or other high-risk scenarios, the identity of the customer shall be established as per paragraph 23 or paragraph 26 and 27.

obligations.text: An NBFC may transfer an account to another branch or office of the same NBFC using a KYC verification done by one branch only if the NBFC has already completed full KYC verification for that account and it is not due for periodic updation.
obligations.quote: provided the NBFC has already completed the full KYC verification for the concerned account and the same is not due for periodic updation.

obligations.text: For opening an account in the name of a sole proprietary firm, the NBFC shall carry out CDD of the individual (proprietor).
obligations.quote: For opening an account in the name of a sole proprietary firm, the NBFC shall carry out the CDD of the individual (proprietor).

obligations.text: In addition to the CDD of the proprietor, the NBFC shall obtain any two of the listed documents, or their equivalent e-documents, as proof of business or activity in the name of the proprietary firm.
obligations.quote: the NBFC shall also obtain any two of the following documents or the equivalent e-documents thereof as proof of business / activity in the name of the proprietary firm

obligations.text: Where the NBFC is satisfied that it is not possible to furnish two documents as proof of business/activity, it may accept only one such document, provided it undertakes contact point verification and collects other required information and clarifications.
obligations.quote: the NBFC undertakes contact point verification and collects such other information and clarifications as would be required to establish the existence of such firm

obligations.text: The NBFC shall confirm and satisfy itself that it has verified the business activity from the address of the proprietary concern.
obligations.quote: shall confirm and satisfy itself that it has verified the business activity from the address of the proprietary concern

obligations.text: For opening an account of a company, the NBFC shall obtain certified copies of the certificate of incorporation, Memorandum and Articles of Association, PAN of the company, and the other listed documents, or their equivalent e-documents.
obligations.quote: For opening an account of a company, the NBFC shall obtain certified copies of each of the following documents or the equivalent e-documents thereof

obligations.text: For a company account, the NBFC shall obtain a resolution from the Board of Directors and power of attorney granted to its managers, officers or employees to transact on its behalf.
obligations.quote: A resolution from the Board of Directors and power of attorney granted to its managers, officers or employees to transact on its behalf

obligations.text: For a company account, the NBFC shall obtain documents specified in paragraph 23 relating to the beneficial owner, managers, officers or employees holding an attorney to transact on the company's behalf.
obligations.quote: Documents, as specified in paragraph 23, relating to beneficial owner, managers, officers or employees, as the case may be, holding an attorney to transact on the company’s behalf

obligations.text: For a company account, the NBFC shall obtain the names of the relevant persons holding a senior management position.
obligations.quote: The names of the relevant persons holding a senior management position

obligations.text: For a company account, the NBFC shall obtain the registered office and the principal place of its business, if it is different.
obligations.quote: The registered office and the principal place of its business, if it is different

obligations.text: For opening an account of a partnership firm, the NBFC shall obtain certified copies of the registration certificate, partnership deed, PAN of the firm, documents under paragraph 23 for beneficial owners/managers/officers/employees holding an attorney to transact on its behalf, names of all partners, and address of the registered office and principal place of business if different, or the equivalent e-documents.
obligations.quote: For opening an account of a partnership firm, the NBFC shall obtain the certified copies of each of the following documents or the equivalent e-documents thereof

obligations.text: For opening an account of a trust, the NBFC shall obtain certified copies of the registration certificate, trust deed, PAN or Form No.60 of the trust, documents under paragraph 23 for beneficial owners/managers/officers/employees holding an attorney to transact on its behalf, names of beneficiaries, trustees, settlor, protector (if any) and authors of the trust, address of the registered office of the trust, and list of trustees with paragraph 23 documents for those authorised to transact on behalf of the trust, or the equivalent e-documents.
obligations.quote: For opening an account of a trust, the NBFC shall obtain the certified copies of each of the following documents or the equivalent e-documents thereof

obligations.text: For opening an account of an unincorporated association or a body of individuals, the NBFC shall obtain certified copies of the resolution of the managing body of such association or body of individuals, or the equivalent e-documents thereof.
obligations.quote: the NBFC shall obtain the certified copies of each of the following documents or the equivalent e-documents thereof: (1) Resolution of the managing body of such association or body of individuals

obligations.text: For opening an account of an unincorporated association or a body of individuals, the NBFC shall obtain certified copies of the PAN or Form No. 60 of the unincorporated association or body of individuals, or the equivalent e-documents thereof.
obligations.quote: PAN or Form No. 60 of the unincorporated association or a body of individuals

obligations.text: For opening an account of an unincorporated association or a body of individuals, the NBFC shall obtain certified copies of the power of attorney granted to transact on its behalf, or the equivalent e-documents thereof.
obligations.quote: Power of attorney granted to transact on its behalf

obligations.text: For opening an account of an unincorporated association or a body of individuals, the NBFC shall obtain certified copies of the documents specified in paragraph 23 relating to the beneficial owner, managers, officers or employees holding an attorney to transact on its behalf, or the equivalent e-documents thereof.
obligations.quote: Documents, as specified in paragraph 23, relating to beneficial owner, managers, officers or employees, as the case may be, holding an attorney to transact on its behalf

obligations.text: For opening an account of an unincorporated association or a body of individuals, the NBFC shall obtain certified copies of such information as it may require to collectively establish the legal existence of such association or body of individuals, or the equivalent e-documents thereof.
obligations.quote: Such information as may be required by the NBFC to collectively establish the legal existence of such an association or body of individuals.

obligations.text: For a customer that is a juridical person (such as societies, universities and local bodies like village panchayats) or that purports to act on behalf of such a juridical person, individual or trust, the NBFC shall obtain and verify certified copies of the following documents or their equivalent e-documents: (1) a document showing the name of the person authorised to act on behalf of the entity; (2) the documents specified in paragraph 23 of the person holding an attorney to transact on its behalf; and (3) such documents as may be required by the NBFC to establish the legal existence of the entity or juridical person.
obligations.quote: the NBFC shall obtain and verify the certified copies of the following documents or the equivalent e-documents thereof

obligations.text: In case of a trust, the NBFC shall ensure that trustees disclose their status at the time of commencement of an account-based relationship or when carrying out transactions as specified in clauses (2), (5), and (6) of paragraph 21.
obligations.quote: the NBFC shall ensure that trustees disclose their status at the time of commencement of an account-based relationship

obligations.text: For opening an account of a Legal Person who is not a natural person, the NBFC shall identify the beneficial owner(s) and shall undertake all reasonable steps in terms of sub-rule (3) of Rule 9 of the Rules to verify their identity.
obligations.quote: For opening an account of a Legal Person who is not a natural person, the NBFC shall identify the beneficial owner(s) and shall undertake all reasonable steps

obligations.text: In cases of trust / nominee or fiduciary accounts, the NBFC shall obtain satisfactory evidence of the identity of the intermediaries and of the persons on whose behalf they are acting, as well as details of the nature of the trust or other arrangements in place.
obligations.quote: the NBFC shall obtain satisfactory evidence of the identity of the intermediaries and of the persons on whose behalf they are acting, as well as details of the nature of the trust

obligations.text: The NBFC shall undertake ongoing due diligence of customers to ensure that their transactions are consistent with their knowledge about the customers, customers' business and risk profile, and the source of funds / wealth.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall undertake ongoing due diligence of customers to ensure that their transactions are consistent with their knowledge about the customers

obligations.text: The NBFC shall necessarily monitor large and complex transactions, including RTGS transactions, and those with unusual patterns inconsistent with the normal and expected activity of the customer, which have no apparent economic rationale or legitimate purpose.
obligations.quote: the NBFC shall necessarily monitor the following types of transactions:

obligations.text: The NBFC shall necessarily monitor transactions which exceed the thresholds prescribed for specific categories of accounts.
obligations.quote: the NBFC shall necessarily monitor the following types of transactions:

obligations.text: The NBFC shall necessarily monitor high account turnover that is inconsistent with the size of the balance maintained.
obligations.quote: the NBFC shall necessarily monitor the following types of transactions:

obligations.text: The NBFC shall necessarily monitor deposits of third-party cheques, drafts, etc. in existing and newly opened accounts followed by cash withdrawals for large amounts.
obligations.quote: the NBFC shall necessarily monitor the following types of transactions:

obligations.text: The NBFC shall align the extent of monitoring with the risk category of the customer.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall align the extent of monitoring with the risk category of the customer.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall put in place a system of periodic review of risk categorisation of accounts, with such periodicity being at least once in every six months, and shall establish the need for applying enhanced due diligence measures.
obligations.deadline: at least once in every six months
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall put in place a system of periodic review of risk categorisation of accounts, with such periodicity being at least once in every six months and shall establish the need for applying enhanced due diligence measures.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall closely monitor the transactions in accounts of marketing firms, especially accounts of Multi-level Marketing (MLM) companies.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall closely monitor the transactions in accounts of marketing firms, especially accounts of Multi-level Marketing (MLM) companies.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall subject high-risk accounts to more intensified monitoring.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall subject high-risk accounts to more intensified monitoring.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall adopt a risk-based approach for periodic updation of KYC so that the CDD information or data is kept up-to-date and relevant, particularly where risk is high.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall adopt a risk-based approach for periodic updation of KYC ensuring that it keeps the information or data collected under CDD is kept up-to-date and relevant, particularly where there is high risk.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall carry out periodic updation of KYC at least once in every two years for high-risk customers, once in every eight years for medium-risk customers, and once in every 10 years for low-risk customers, counted from the date of account opening or last KYC updation.
obligations.deadline: once in every two years (high risk), eight years (medium risk), 10 years (low risk)
obligations.quote: the NBFC shall carry out periodic updation at least once in every two years for high-risk customers, once in every eight years for medium risk customers and once in every 10 years for low-risk customers

obligations.text: The NBFC shall document its periodic updation policy as part of its internal KYC policy duly approved by the Board of Directors or a committee of the Board to which power has been delegated.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall document its policy in this regard as part of the NBFC’s internal KYC policy duly approved by the Board of Directors of NBFC or any committee of the Board to which power has been delegated.

obligations.text: For individual low-risk customers, the NBFC shall allow all transactions and ensure KYC updation within one year of falling due or up to June 30, 2026, whichever is later.
obligations.applies_to: NBFC; individual customers categorised as low-risk
obligations.deadline: within one year of falling due for KYC or up to June 30, 2026, whichever is later
obligations.quote: the NBFC shall allow all transactions and ensure the updation of KYC within one year of its falling due for KYC or up to June 30, 2026, whichever is later.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall subject accounts of individual low-risk customers to regular monitoring, including those for whom periodic updation has already fallen due.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall subject accounts of such customers to regular monitoring. This shall also apply to low-risk individual customers for whom periodic updation of KYC has already fallen due.
