obligations.text: In case of no change in KYC information, the NBFC shall obtain a self-declaration from the individual customer through registered email-id, registered mobile number, digital channels (including its mobile application), letter, etc.
obligations.quote: In case of no change in the KYC information, the NBFC shall obtain a self-declaration from the customer in this regard through the customer’s email-id registered with the NBFC

obligations.text: In case of a change only in address, the NBFC shall obtain a self-declaration of the new address from the customer through registered email-id, registered mobile number, ATMs, digital channels, letter, etc.
obligations.quote: In case of a change only in the address details of the customer, the NBFC shall obtain a self-declaration of the new address from the customer

obligations.text: The NBFC shall verify the declared new address through positive confirmation within two months, by means such as address verification letter, contact point verification, or deliverables.
obligations.quote: and shall verify the declared address through positive confirmation within two months, by means such as address verification letter, contact point verification, deliverables, etc.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall clearly specify the requirement in its internal KYC policy duly approved by the Board of Directors of the NBFC or any committee of the Board to which power has been delegated.
obligations.quote: the NBFC shall clearly specify such requirement, in its internal KYC policy duly approved by the Board of Directors of the NBFC or any committee of the Board to which power has been delegated.

obligations.text: For customers whose account was opened while they were minors, the NBFC shall obtain fresh photographs upon their becoming major.
obligations.quote: the NBFC shall obtain fresh photographs upon their becoming a major and, at that time, shall ensure that CDD documents as per the current CDD standards are available.

obligations.text: On customers becoming major, the NBFC shall ensure that CDD documents as per the current CDD standards are available.
obligations.quote: shall ensure that CDD documents as per the current CDD standards are available.

obligations.text: For no change in KYC information of an LE customer, the NBFC shall obtain a self-declaration from the LE customer through its registered email, ATMs, digital channels, authorised official letter, board resolution, etc.
obligations.quote: In case of no change in the KYC information of the LE customer, the NBFC shall obtain a self-declaration in this regard from the LE customer through its email id registered with the NBFC

obligations.text: During the self-declaration process for LE customers with no KYC change, the NBFC shall ensure Beneficial Ownership information is accurate and update it if required to keep it as up-to-date as possible.
obligations.quote: Further, the NBFC shall ensure during this process that Beneficial Ownership (BO) information available with them is accurate and shall update the same, if required

obligations.text: In case of change in KYC information of an LE customer, the NBFC shall undertake the KYC process equivalent to that applicable for onboarding a new LE customer.
obligations.quote: In case of change in KYC information, the NBFC shall undertake the KYC process equivalent to that applicable for onboarding a new LE customer.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall ensure that the mobile number for Aadhaar authentication is the same as the one available in the customer's profile, to prevent fraud.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall ensure that the mobile number for Aadhaar authentication is same as the one available with them in the customer’s profile, in order to prevent any fraud.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall ensure that it has the customer's KYC documents as per the current CDD standards available with it, even if there is no change in customer information but the documents are not as per current CDD standards.
obligations.quote: the NBFC shall ensure that: (i) The NBFC has customer's KYC document as per the current CDD standards available with it.

obligations.text: Where the validity of CDD documents available with the NBFC has expired at the time of periodic updation of KYC, the NBFC shall undertake the KYC process equivalent to that applicable for onboarding a new customer.
obligations.quote: in case the validity of the CDD documents available with the NBFC has expired at the time of periodic updation of KYC, the NBFC shall undertake the KYC process equivalent to that applicable for onboarding a new customer.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall verify the customer's PAN details, if available, from the database of the issuing authority at the time of periodic updation of KYC.
obligations.deadline: At the time of periodic updation of KYC
obligations.quote: The NBFC verifies the Customer's PAN details, if available, from the database of the issuing authority at the time of periodic updation of KYC.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall provide an acknowledgment to the customer mentioning the date of receipt of the relevant documents, including self-declaration, for carrying out updation or periodic updation of KYC.
obligations.quote: The NBFC provides an acknowledgment to the customer mentioning the date of receipt of the relevant document(s), including self-declaration from the customer, for carrying out updation / periodic updation.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall promptly update the information or documents obtained from customers at the time of updation or periodic updation of KYC in its records or database, and provide an intimation to the customer mentioning the date of updation of KYC details.
obligations.quote: the NBFC shall ensure that it promptly updates the information / documents obtained from the customers at the time of updation / periodic updation of KYC in its records / database and provide an intimation, mentioning the date of updation of KYC details, to the customer.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall adopt a risk-based approach with respect to periodic updation of KYC.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall adopt a risk-based approach with respect to periodic updation of KYC.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall clearly specify in its internal policy, duly approved by the Board or a delegated committee of the Board, any additional and exceptional measures it adopts that are not otherwise mandated under the above instructions.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall clearly specify in its internal policy, duly approved by the Board of Directors of the NBFC or any committee of the Board to which power has been delegated, any additional and exceptional measures, it adopts that are not otherwise mandated

obligations.text: The NBFC shall advise customers that, in order to comply with the PML Rules, they must submit updated documents in case of any change in the documents they submitted at the time of account opening.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall advise the customers that in order to comply with the PML Rules, in case of any update in the documents submitted by the customer at the time

obligations.text: Customers shall submit to the NBFC the update of their KYC documents within 30 days of the update to the documents, for the purpose of updating the records at the NBFC's end.
obligations.deadline: within 30 days of the update to the documents
obligations.quote: customers shall submit to the NBFC the update of such documents. This shall be done within 30 days of the update to the documents for the purpose of updating the records at the NBFC's end.

obligations.text: Prior to the due date of periodic updation of KYC, the NBFC shall give customers at least three advance intimations, including at least one intimation by letter, at appropriate intervals through available communication options or channels.
obligations.deadline: Prior to the due date of periodic updation of KYC
obligations.quote: Prior to the due date of periodic updation of KYC, the NBFC shall give at least three advance intimations, including at least one intimation by letter, at appropriate intervals to its customers

obligations.text: Subsequent to the due date, the NBFC shall give at least three reminders, including at least one reminder by letter, at appropriate intervals, to customers who have still not complied despite advance intimations.
obligations.deadline: Subsequent to the due date of periodic updation of KYC
obligations.quote: Subsequent to the due date, the NBFC shall give at least three reminders, including at least one reminder by letter, at appropriate intervals, to such customers who have still not complied with the requirements

obligations.text: Issue of each advance intimation or reminder shall be duly recorded in the NBFC's system against each customer for audit trail.
obligations.quote: Issue of such advance intimation / reminder shall be duly recorded in the NBFC's system against each customer for audit trail.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall expeditiously implement the due notices requirement for periodic updation of KYC, and in any case not later than January 01, 2026.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall expeditiously implement the same but not later than January 01, 2026.

obligations.text: If an existing customer does not provide PAN or equivalent e-document or Form No. 60 by the notified date, the NBFC shall temporarily cease operations in the account until the customer submits them.
obligations.deadline: Date which the Central Government may notify
obligations.quote: failing which the NBFC shall temporarily cease operations in the account until the customer submits the PAN or equivalent e-documents thereof or Form No. 60

obligations.text: Before temporarily ceasing operations for an account, the NBFC shall give the customer an accessible notice and a reasonable opportunity to be heard.
obligations.quote: the NBFC shall give the customer an accessible notice and a reasonable opportunity to be heard

obligations.text: The NBFC shall include in its internal policy appropriate relaxation(s) for continued operation of accounts of customers unable to provide PAN or Form No. 60 due to injury, illness or infirmity on account of old age or otherwise.
obligations.quote: the NBFC shall include, in its internal policy, appropriate relaxation(s) for continued operation of accounts for customers who are unable to provide PAN

obligations.text: The NBFC shall subject accounts granted relaxation for customers unable to provide PAN or Form No. 60 to enhanced monitoring.
obligations.quote: However, the NBFC shall subject such accounts to enhanced monitoring.

obligations.text: If an existing customer gives written notice that they do not want to submit PAN or equivalent e-document or Form No. 60, the NBFC shall close the account and settle all dues after establishing the customer's identity.
obligations.quote: the NBFC shall close the account and all obligations due in relation to the account shall be appropriately settled after establishing the identity of the customer

obligations.text: If the NBFC has introduced V-CIP, it shall provide V-CIP as the first option to the customer for remote onboarding.
obligations.quote: If the NBFC has introduced the process of V-CIP, it shall provide the same as the first option to the customer for remote onboarding.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall not link alternate mobile numbers post CDD with such accounts for transaction OTP or transaction updates.
obligations.quote: alternate mobile numbers shall not be linked post CDD with such accounts for transaction OTP, transaction updates, etc.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall permit transactions only from the mobile number used for account opening.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall permit transactions only from the mobile number used for account opening.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall have a Board-approved policy delineating a robust process of due diligence for dealing with requests for change of registered mobile number.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall have a Board-approved policy delineating a robust process of due diligence for dealing with requests for change of registered mobile number.

obligations.text: Apart from obtaining current address proof, the NBFC shall verify the current address through positive confirmation before allowing operations in the account.
obligations.quote: Apart from obtaining the current address proof, the NBFC shall verify the current address through positive confirmation before allowing operations in the account.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall obtain PAN from the customer and verify the PAN from the verification facility of the issuing authority.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall obtain PAN from the customer and the PAN shall be verified from the verification facility of the issuing authority.

obligations.text: The first transaction in such non-face-to-face accounts shall be a credit from an existing KYC-complied bank account of the customer.
obligations.quote: First transaction in such accounts shall be a credit from existing KYC-complied bank account of the customer.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall categorise customers onboarded non-face-to-face as high-risk and subject their accounts to enhanced monitoring until identity is verified face-to-face or through V-CIP.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall categorise such customers as high-risk customers and shall subject accounts opened in non-face-to-face mode to enhanced monitoring until the identity of the customer is verified in face-to-face manner or through V-CIP.

obligations.text: Apart from performing normal customer due diligence, the NBFC must have in place appropriate risk management systems to determine whether the customer or the beneficial owner is a PEP before establishing a relationship with PEPs.
obligations.quote: The NBFC has in place appropriate risk management systems to determine whether the customer or the beneficial owner is a PEP;

obligations.text: The NBFC shall take reasonable measures for establishing the source of funds / wealth of PEPs.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall take reasonable measures for establishing the source of funds / wealth;

obligations.text: The NBFC shall obtain approval from senior management to open an account for a PEP.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall obtain approval to open an account for a PEP from the senior management;

obligations.text: The NBFC must subject all PEP accounts to enhanced monitoring on an on-going basis.
obligations.quote: The NBFC subjects all such accounts to enhanced monitoring on an on-going basis;

obligations.text: Where an existing customer or beneficial owner of an existing account subsequently becomes a PEP, the NBFC must obtain senior management's approval to continue the business relationship.
obligations.quote: in the event of an existing customer or the beneficial owner of an existing account subsequently becoming a PEP, the NBFC obtains the senior management’s approval to continue the business relationship;

obligations.text: The PEP instructions in this section shall also apply to family members or close associates of PEPs.
obligations.quote: These instructions shall also apply to family members or close associates of PEPs.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall identify clients when a professional intermediary opens a client account on behalf of a single client.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall identify clients when a professional intermediary opens a client account on behalf of a single client.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall not open accounts of professional intermediaries who are bound by any client confidentiality which prohibits disclosure of the client details to the NBFC.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall not open accounts of such professional intermediaries who are bound by any client confidentiality which prohibits disclosure of the client details to the NBFC.

obligations.text: Where intermediaries do not co-mingle funds at the NBFC level and there are sub-accounts each attributable to a beneficial owner, the NBFC shall identify all the beneficial owners.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall identify all the beneficial owners where intermediaries do not co-mingle funds at the level of the NBFC, and there are 'sub- accounts', each of them attributable to a beneficial owner

obligations.text: Where funds are co-mingled at the level of the NBFC, the NBFC shall look for the beneficial owners.
obligations.quote: or where such funds are co-mingled at the level of the NBFC, the NBFC shall look for the beneficial owners.

obligations.text: When relying on CDD done by an intermediary, the NBFC shall ensure the intermediary is a regulated and supervised entity with adequate systems in place to comply with KYC requirements of customers.
obligations.quote: provided that the intermediary is a regulated and supervised entity and has adequate systems in place to comply with the KYC requirements of the customers.

obligations.text: The ultimate responsibility for knowing the customer lies with the NBFC.
obligations.quote: The ultimate responsibility for knowing the customer lies with the NBFC.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall maintain all necessary records of transactions between the NBFC and the customer, both domestic and international, for at least five years from the date of transaction.
obligations.deadline: at least five years from the date of transaction
obligations.quote: maintain all necessary records of transactions between the NBFC and the customer, both domestic and international, for at least five years from the date of transaction;

obligations.text: The NBFC shall preserve the records pertaining to the identification of customers and their addresses, obtained while opening the account and during the course of business relationship, for at least five years after the business relationship has ended.
obligations.deadline: at least five years after the business relationship has ended
obligations.quote: preserve the records pertaining to the identification of the customers and their addresses, obtained while opening the account and during the course of business relationship, for at least five years after the business relationship has ended;

obligations.text: The NBFC shall swiftly make available the identification records and transaction data to the competent authorities upon request.
obligations.quote: swiftly make available, the identification records and transaction data to the competent authorities upon request;

obligations.text: The NBFC shall introduce a system of maintaining proper records of transactions prescribed under Rule 3 of the PML Rules, 2005.
obligations.quote: introduce a system of maintaining proper records of transactions prescribed under Rule 3 of Prevention of Money Laundering (Maintenance of Records) Rules, 2005 (PML Rules, 2005);

obligations.text: The NBFC shall maintain all necessary information in respect of transactions prescribed under PML Rule 3 to permit reconstruction of an individual transaction, including the nature of the transaction, its amount and currency, the date conducted, and the parties to the transaction.
obligations.quote: maintain all necessary information in respect of transactions prescribed under PML Rule 3 to permit the reconstruction of an individual transaction, including the following:

obligations.text: The NBFC shall evolve a system for proper maintenance and preservation of account information that allows it to retrieve data easily and quickly whenever required or when competent authorities request it.
obligations.quote: evolve a system for proper maintenance and preservation of account information in a manner that allows the NBFC to retrieve data easily and quickly whenever required or when competent authorities request it;

obligations.text: The NBFC shall maintain records of the identity and address of its customers, and records in respect of transactions referred to in Rule 3, in hard or soft format.
obligations.quote: maintain records of the identity and address of its customers, and records in respect of transactions referred to in Rule 3 in hard or soft format.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall ensure that, for customers who are non-profit organisations, it registers details of such customers on the DARPAN Portal of NITI Aayog.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall ensure that in case of customers who are non-profit organisations, the NBFC registers details of such customers on the DARPAN Portal of NITI Aayog.

obligations.text: If a non-profit organisation customer is not registered on the DARPAN Portal, the NBFC shall register the customer's details on the DARPAN Portal.
obligations.quote: If they are not registered, the NBFC shall register the details on the DARPAN Portal.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall maintain DARPAN registration records of non-profit organisation customers for five years after the business relationship has ended or the account has been closed, whichever is later.
obligations.deadline: Five years after the business relationship ends or the account is closed, whichever is later
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall also maintain such registration records for a period of five years after the business relationship between the customer and the NBFC has ended or the account has been closed, whichever is later.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall furnish to the Director, Financial Intelligence Unit-India (FIU-IND), the information referred to in Rule 3 of the PML (Maintenance of Records) Rules, 2005 in accordance with Rule 7 thereof.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall furnish to the Director, Financial Intelligence Unit-India (FIU-IND), the information referred to in Rule 3 of the PML (Maintenance of Records) Rules, 2005 in accordance with Rule 7 thereof.

obligations.text: The NBFC which is yet to install or adopt suitable technological tools for extracting CTR/STR from its live transaction data shall make use of the editable electronic utilities to file electronic CTRs/STRs placed on the FIU-IND website.
obligations.applies_to: The NBFC which is yet to install / adopt suitable technological tools for extracting CTR / STR from its live transaction data
obligations.quote: The NBFC which is yet to install / adopt suitable technological tools for extracting CTR / STR from its live transaction data shall make use of the editable electronic utilities to file electronic Cash Transaction Reports

obligations.text: The Principal Officer of the NBFC shall have suitable arrangement to cull out transaction details from branches which are yet to be computerised and feed the data into an electronic file using the editable electronic utilities of CTR/STR made available by FIU-IND.
obligations.quote: The Principal Officer of the NBFC, shall have suitable arrangement to cull out the transaction details from branches which are yet to be computerised and to feed the data into an electronic file

obligations.text: The NBFC shall not put any restriction on operations in the accounts merely on the basis of the STR filed.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall not put any restriction on operations in the accounts merely on the basis of the STR filed.

obligations.text: The NBFC, its directors, officers, and all employees shall ensure that the fact of maintenance of records referred to in rule 3 of the PML (Maintenance of Records) Rules, 2005, and furnishing of information to the Director is confidential.
obligations.applies_to: The NBFC, its directors, officers, and all employees
obligations.quote: The NBFC, its directors, officers, and all employees shall ensure that the fact of maintenance of records referred to in rule 3 of the PML (Maintenance of Records) Rules, 2005, and furnishing of the information to the Director is confidential.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall implement robust software that generates alerts when transactions are inconsistent with a customer's risk categorisation and updated profile.
obligations.quote: the NBFC shall implement robust software that generates alerts when transactions are inconsistent with a customer's risk categorisation and updated profile.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall ensure that, in terms of section 51A of the UAPA Act, 1967 and amendments thereto, it does not have any account in the name of individuals or entities appearing in the UNSC-approved lists of individuals and entities suspected of having terrorist links.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall ensure that in terms of section 51A of the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) (UAPA) Act, 1967 and amendments thereto, it does not have any account in the name of individuals / entities appearing in the lists

obligations.text: The NBFC shall also refer to the lists as available in the Schedules to the Prevention and Suppression of Terrorism (Implementation of Security Council Resolutions) Order, 2007, as amended from time to time.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall also ensure to refer to the lists as available in the Schedules to the Prevention and Suppression of Terrorism (Implementation of Security Council Resolutions) Order, 2007, as amended from time to time.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall verify the UNSC Sanctions Lists and the lists in the Schedules to the 2007 Order on a daily basis, and take into account any additions, deletions or other modifications to the lists for meticulous compliance.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall verify the aforementioned lists, i.e., UNSC Sanctions Lists and lists as available in the Schedules to the Prevention and Suppression of Terrorism (Implementation of Security Council Resolutions) Order, 2007, as amended from time to time, on a daily basis

obligations.text: The NBFC shall report the details of accounts resembling any of the individuals or entities in the lists to FIU-IND, in addition to advising the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) as required under the UAPA notification dated February 2, 2021.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall report the details of accounts resembling any of the individuals / entities in the lists to FIU-IND in addition to advising the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA)

obligations.text: The NBFC shall strictly follow the procedure laid down in the UAPA Order dated February 2, 2021 (Annex – I of these Directions) for freezing of assets under section 51A of UAPA, 1967.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall strictly follow the procedure laid down in the UAPA Order dated February 2, 2021 (Annex – I of these Directions), and shall ensure the meticulous compliance with the Order issued by the Government.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall ensure the meticulous compliance with the Order issued by the Government on freezing of assets under section 51A of UAPA, 1967.
obligations.quote: shall ensure the meticulous compliance with the Order issued by the Government. The list of Nodal Officers for UAPA is available on the website of MHA.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall ensure meticulous compliance with the 'Procedure for Implementation of section 12A of the WMD Act, 2005' laid down by the Ministry of Finance Order dated September 1, 2023 (Annex II of these Directions).
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall ensure meticulous compliance with the ‘Procedure for Implementation of section 12A of the Weapons of Mass Destruction (WMD) and their Delivery Systems (Prohibition of Unlawful Activities) Act, 2005’

obligations.text: The NBFC shall ensure not to carry out transactions where the particulars of an individual or entity match the particulars in the designated list.
obligations.quote: the NBFC shall ensure not to carry out transactions in case the particulars of the individual / entity match with the particulars in the designated list.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall run a check on the given parameters at the time of establishing a relation with a customer and on a periodic basis to verify whether individuals and entities in the designated list hold any funds or financial assets in NBFC accounts.
obligations.quote: the NBFC shall run a check, on the given parameters, at the time of establishing a relation with a customer and on a periodic basis

obligations.text: On a match, the NBFC shall immediately inform the Central Nodal Officer (CNO) of the transaction details with full particulars of the funds, financial assets or economic resources involved.
obligations.quote: the NBFC shall immediately inform the transaction details with full particulars of the funds, financial assets or economic resources involved to the Central Nodal Officer (CNO)

obligations.text: The NBFC shall prevent an individual or entity designated under section 12A of the WMD Act, 2005 from conducting financial transactions, with intimation to the CNO by email, FAX and by post, without delay.
obligations.quote: 12A of the WMD Act, 2005, the NBFC shall prevent such individual / entity from conducting financial transactions, under intimation to the CNO by email, FAX and by post, without delay.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall verify every day the UNSCR 1718 Sanctions List of Designated Individuals and Entities to take into account any modifications in terms of additions, deletions or other changes.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall ensure compliance with the Implementation of Security Council Resolution on Democratic People's Republic of Korea Order, 2017, as amended from time to time by the Central Government.

obligations.text: In addition to the UNSCR 1718 list, the NBFC shall take into account other UNSCRs.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall undertake countermeasures when called upon to do so by any international or intergovernmental organisation of which India is a member and which is accepted by the Central Government.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall undertake countermeasures when called upon so to do by any international or intergovernmental organisation of which India is a member and which is accepted by the Central Government.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall consider the FATF Statements circulated by the RBI from time to time, and publicly available information, for identifying countries which do not or insufficiently apply the FATF Recommendations.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall consider the FATF Statements circulated by the RBI from time to time, and publicly available information, for identifying countries, which do not or insufficiently apply the FATF Recommendations.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall apply enhanced due diligence measures, which are effective and proportionate to the risks, to business relationships and transactions with natural and legal persons (including financial institutions) from countries for which this is called for by the FATF.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall apply enhanced due diligence measures, which are effective and proportionate to the risks, to business relationships and transactions with natural and legal persons (including financial institutions) from countries for which this is called for by the FATF.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall give special attention to business relationships and transactions with persons (including legal persons and other financial institutions) from or in countries that do not or insufficiently apply the FATF Recommendations and jurisdictions included in FATF Statements.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall give special attention to business relationships and transactions with persons (including legal persons and other financial institutions) from or in countries that do not or insufficiently apply the FATF Recommendations and jurisdictions included in FATF Statements.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall examine the background and purpose of transactions with persons (including legal persons and other financial institutions) from jurisdictions included in FATF Statements and countries that do not or insufficiently apply the FATF Recommendations.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall examine the background and purpose of transactions with persons (including legal persons and other financial institutions) from jurisdictions included in FATF Statements and countries that do not or insufficiently apply the FATF Recommendations

obligations.text: The NBFC shall retain written findings of its examination of such transactions together with all documents, and make them available to the RBI / other relevant authorities, on request.
obligations.quote: retain written findings together with all documents, and make them available to the RBI / other relevant authorities, on request.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall maintain secrecy regarding the customer information that arises out of the contractual relationship between the NBFC and the customer.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall maintain secrecy regarding the customer information that arises out of the contractual relationship between the NBFC and the customer.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall treat information collected from customers for the purpose of opening of account as confidential.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall treat information collected from customers for the purpose of opening of account as confidential and shall not divulge details thereof

obligations.text: The NBFC shall not divulge details of information collected from customers for opening of account for the purpose of cross-selling, or for any other purpose, without the express permission of the customer.
obligations.quote: shall not divulge details thereof for the purpose of cross-selling, or for any other purpose without the express permission of the customer.

obligations.text: While considering requests for data or information from Government and other agencies, the NBFC shall satisfy itself that the information sought is not of such a nature as will violate the provisions of laws relating to secrecy in the transactions.
obligations.quote: the NBFC shall satisfy itself that the information being sought is not of such a nature as will violate the provisions of the laws relating to secrecy in the transactions.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall ensure adherence to the provisions of the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Act, 2010, and Rules made thereunder.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall ensure adherence to the provisions of Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Act, 2010, and Rules made thereunder.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall ensure meticulous compliance with any instructions or communications on the matter issued from time to time by the RBI based on advice received from the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India.
obligations.quote: the NBFC shall also ensure meticulous compliance with any instructions / communications on the matter issued from time to time by the RBI based on advice received from the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall capture customer KYC records and upload them onto CKYCR within 10 days of commencement of an account-based relationship with the customer.

obligations.quote: the NBFC shall capture customer’s KYC records and upload onto CKYCR within 10 days of commencement of an account-based relationship with the customer.

obligations.quote: The NBFC shall capture the KYC information for sharing with the CKYCR in the manner mentioned in the Rules, as per the KYC templates prepared for ‘Individuals’ and ‘Legal Entities’ (LEs), as the case may be.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall upload KYC data pertaining to all new individual accounts opened on or after April 1, 2017, with CKYCR in terms of the provisions of the Rules.
obligations.deadline: For individual accounts opened on or after April 1, 2017
obligations.quote: NBFC shall upload the KYC data pertaining to all new individual accounts opened on or after from April 1, 2017, with CKYCR in terms of the provisions of the Rules ibid.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall upload KYC records pertaining to accounts of LEs opened on or after April 1, 2021, with CKYCR in terms of the provisions of the Rules, using the LE Template released by CERSAI.
obligations.deadline: For LE accounts opened on or after April 1, 2021
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall upload KYC records pertaining to accounts of LEs opened on or after April 1, 2021, with CKYCR in terms of the provisions of the Rules ibid.

obligations.text: Once CKYCR generates a KYC Identifier, the NBFC shall ensure that it is communicated to the individual or LE as the case may be.
obligations.quote: Once KYC Identifier is generated by CKYCR, the NBFC shall ensure that the same is communicated to the individual / LE as the case may be.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall upload or update KYC data for pre-existing individual and LE accounts opened before the dates in clauses (4) and (5), at periodic updation or earlier when updated KYC information is obtained from the customer.
obligations.deadline: At the time of periodic updation as specified in paragraph 42, or earlier when updated information is obtained
obligations.quote: the NBFC shall upload / update the KYC data pertaining to accounts of individual customers and LEs opened prior to the above-mentioned dates as per clauses (4) and (5), respectively, at the time of periodic updation as specified in paragraph 42

obligations.text: Where the NBFC obtains additional or updated information from any customer, it shall furnish the updated information to CKYCR within seven days or within such period as may be notified by the Central Government.
obligations.deadline: Within seven days or such period as may be notified by the Central Government
obligations.quote: the NBFC shall within seven days or within such period as may be notified by the Central Government, furnish the updated information

obligations.text: Upon receiving updated KYC information from a customer, the regulated entity must furnish the updated information to CKYCR, which then updates the KYC records of the existing customer in CKYCR.
obligations.quote: to CKYCR, which shall update the KYC records of the existing customer in CKYCR.

obligations.text: Once CKYCR informs the NBFC of an update in the KYC record of an existing customer, the NBFC shall retrieve the updated KYC records from CKYCR and update the KYC record maintained by the NBFC.
obligations.quote: Once CKYCR informs the NBFC regarding an update in the KYC record of an existing customer, the NBFC shall retrieve the updated KYC records from CKYCR and update the KYC record maintained by the NBFC.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall ensure that during periodic updation, customers are migrated to the current CDD standard.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall ensure that during periodic updation, the customers are migrated to the current CDD standard.

obligations.text: For establishing an account-based relationship, updation or periodic updation, or verification of identity, the NBFC shall seek the KYC Identifier from the customer or retrieve it from CKYCR if available, and proceed to obtain KYC records online using it.
obligations.quote: the NBFC shall seek the KYC Identifier from the customer or retrieve the KYC Identifier, if available, from the CKYCR and proceed to obtain KYC records online by using such KYC Identifier

obligations.quote: Develop Information Technology (IT) framework for carrying out due diligence procedure and for recording and maintaining the same, as provided in Rule 114H.

obligations.quote: Develop a system of audit for the IT framework and compliance with Rules 114F, 114G and 114H of Income Tax Rules.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall constitute a 'High-Level Monitoring Committee' under the Designated Director or any other equivalent functionary to ensure compliance.
obligations.quote: Constitute a ‘High-Level Monitoring Committee’ under the Designated Director or any other equivalent functionary to ensure compliance.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall ensure compliance with updated instructions, rules, guidance notes and press releases issued by CBDT from time to time on the subject.
obligations.quote: Ensure compliance with updated instructions / rules / guidance notes / press releases issued on the subject by Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) from time to time

obligations.text: The NBFC shall strictly adhere to the instructions on opening of accounts and monitoring of transactions in order to minimise the operation of Money Mules.
obligations.quote: The instructions on opening of accounts and monitoring of transactions shall be strictly adhered to, in order to minimise the operations of "Money Mules"

obligations.text: The NBFC shall undertake diligence measures and meticulous monitoring to identify accounts operated as Money Mules and take appropriate action, including reporting suspicious transactions to FIU-IND.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall undertake diligence measures and meticulous monitoring to identify accounts which are operated as Money Mules and take appropriate action, including reporting of suspicious transactions to FIU-IND.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall allot a UCIC while entering into new relationships with individual customers as also existing individual customers.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall allot UCIC while entering into new relationships with individual customers as also the existing individual customers.

obligations.quote: provided it is ensured that there is adequate mechanism to identify such walk-in customers who have frequent transactions with them and ensure that they are allotted UCIC.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall identify and assess the ML/TF risks that may arise in relation to the development of new products and new business practices, including new delivery mechanisms, and the use of new or developing technologies for both new and existing products.
obligations.quote: The NBFC shall identify and assess the ML / TF risks that may arise in relation to the development of new products and new business practices, including new delivery mechanisms

obligations.quote: to undertake the ML / TF risk assessments prior to the launch or use of such products, practices, services, technologies

obligations.text: The NBFC shall ensure adoption of a risk-based approach to manage and mitigate the risks through appropriate EDD measures and transaction monitoring, etc.
obligations.quote: adoption of a risk-based approach to manage and mitigate the risks through appropriate EDD measures and transaction monitoring, etc.

obligations.text: All cross-border wire transfers shall be accompanied by accurate, complete, and meaningful originator and beneficiary information as mentioned below.
obligations.quote: All cross-border wire transfers shall be accompanied by accurate, complete, and meaningful originator and beneficiary information as mentioned below

obligations.quote: All cross-border wire transfers shall be accompanied by accurate, complete, and meaningful originator and beneficiary information as mentioned below

obligations.text: Cross-border wire transfers must include the originator account number where such an account is used to process the transaction.
obligations.quote: the originator account number where such an account is used to process the transaction

obligations.text: Cross-border wire transfers must include the originator's address, or national identity number, or customer identification number, or date and place of birth.
obligations.quote: the originator’s address, or national identity number, or customer identification number, or date and place of birth

obligations.text: For cross-border wire transfers, the ordering NBFC must include the name of the beneficiary and the beneficiary account number where such an account is used to process the transaction.
obligations.quote: (d) name of the beneficiary; and (e) the beneficiary account number where such an account is used to process the transaction.

obligations.text: In cross-border wire transfers where there is no account, a unique transaction reference number should be included that permits traceability of the transaction.
obligations.quote: In the absence of an account, a unique transaction reference number should be included which permits traceability of the transaction.

obligations.text: In a batch transfer, individual cross-border wire transfers are exempt from the originator information requirement only if they include the originator's account number or unique transaction reference number, and the batch file contains required and accurate originator information and full beneficiary information that is fully traceable within the beneficiary country.
obligations.quote: provided that they include the originator's account number or unique transaction reference number, as mentioned above, and the batch file contains required and accurate originator information, and full beneficiary information

obligations.text: Domestic wire transfers where the originator is an account holder of the ordering NBFC shall be accompanied by originator and beneficiary information as indicated for cross-border wire transfers.
obligations.quote: Domestic wire transfer, where the originator is an account holder of the ordering NBFC, shall be accompanied by originator and beneficiary information, as indicated for cross-border wire transfers in (i) and (ii) above.

obligations.quote: the ordering NBFC shall make the information available within three working / business days of receiving the request from the intermediary RE, beneficiary RE, or from appropriate competent authorities.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall ensure that all information on wire transfers is immediately made available to appropriate law enforcement authorities, prosecuting authorities.

obligations.quote: Ordering NBFC shall not execute the wire transfer if it is not able to comply with the requirements stipulated in this paragraph.

obligations.text: The NBFC processing an intermediary element of a chain of wire transfers shall ensure that all originator and beneficiary information accompanying a wire transfer is retained with the transfer.

obligations.quote: The NBFC processing an intermediary element of a chain of wire transfers shall ensure that all originator and beneficiary information accompanying a wire transfer is retained with the transfer.

obligations.quote: the intermediary NBFC shall keep a record, for at least five years, of all the information received from the ordering financial institution or another intermediary RE.

obligations.text: Intermediary NBFC shall take reasonable measures to identify cross-border wire transfers that lack required originator information or required beneficiary information, consistent with straight-through processing.
obligations.quote: Intermediary NBFC shall take reasonable measures to identify cross- border wire transfers that lack required originator information or required beneficiary information.

obligations.quote: Intermediary NBFC shall have effective risk-based policies and procedures for determining:

obligations.quote: Beneficiary NBFC shall take reasonable measures, including post-event monitoring or real-time monitoring where feasible, to identify cross- border wire transfers and qualifying domestic wire transfers

obligations.text: Beneficiary NBFC shall have effective risk-based policies and procedures for determining when to execute, reject, or suspend a wire transfer lacking required originator or required beneficiary information.

obligations.quote: Money Transfer Service Scheme (MTSS) providers and other NBFCs, shall comply with all of the relevant requirements of this paragraph, whether they are providing services directly or through their agents.

obligations.quote: (b) file an STR with FIU, in accordance with the PML Rules, if a transaction is found to be suspicious.

obligations.text: The NBFC shall be cognizant of its obligations under these instructions and ensure strict compliance in respect of engagement or involvement of any unregulated entities in the process of wire transfer.

obligations.quote: AML software capable of capturing, generating and analysing alerts for the purpose of filing CTR / STR in respect of transactions relating to third party products with customers including walk-in customers shall be available.
